# Bestiary

Blocks of the phone we have not finished understanding, shown as creatures to face.

Each creature is a block of the phone. Its **fronts** are the precise points the [hardware map](03-hardware-map.md) still lists as open. The life bar is computed from the states written in `tools/bestiary.yaml`: a front that is down must cite an evidence folder, and the generator checks that the cited line is really in it. What a measurement demonstrates is still decided by a human review, in a pull request. In the spirit of a barcode card, a creature is also a **code to find**: each front is one slot of it, shown as `?` until a proof reveals it.

## How a front goes down

- **Open**: nothing established. The bar is full for this front.
- **Wounded**: read in the firmware or in code (SOURCE), not yet seen working on the phone. Half a point of life is gone.
- **Down**: observed on the real phone (DEVICE), with an evidence folder you can open and rebuild. The point is gone.
- A creature is **defeated** when every front is down. That means its **goal** is reached, not that the block is understood: new questions may appear after a victory.
- It is called *unspotted* while it is not even in the hardware map.

## The Whisperer

*Wi-Fi and its coprocessor* · **Wounded**

**Goal** (bounded: reaching it does not mean the block is understood): Start the coprocessor and get an identified answer from the Wi-Fi chip.

<p class="bestiary-bar" role="img" aria-label="Life: 5 of 8 points left">▰▰▰▰▰▰▱▱▱▱</p>

Life: 5 of 8

<p class="bestiary-code" role="img" aria-label="Code: 1 of 4 slots found"><code>1</code> &nbsp;·&nbsp; <code>?</code> &nbsp;·&nbsp; <code>?</code> &nbsp;·&nbsp; <code>?</code></p>

- **Down: seen on the phone.** The base address and the GPIO lines of the Wi-Fi block. Fragment: <code>1</code> (The level of the reset line after it is released). Proof: [`20261015T174633Z-trace_wifi_reset`](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/tree/main/evidence/20261015T174633Z-trace_wifi_reset).
- **Wounded: read in code.** How the coprocessor is started: its start-up sequence, read in the firmware but never run by us. Reading: [`research/2026-10-16-wifi-iop-architecture.md`](../research/2026-10-16-wifi-iop-architecture.md).
    - Attack it: [Which class receives the coprocessor start call?](missions.md#mission-arm7m-startcpu-q4) (no phone) · [What do the object-slot calls of the coprocessor start sequence do?](missions.md#mission-embiop-seq-q1) (no phone)
- **Open.** Which physical clock gate feeds the coprocessor.
    - Attack it: [Which object implements the clock-gate call?](missions.md#mission-s5l-clk-q1) (no phone) · [Do the clock mask registers mirror the gate words?](missions.md#mission-s5l-clk-q2) (needs a phone, reads only)
- **Open.** Why writes from the main processor to the Wi-Fi registers do not stick.
    - No mission yet for this front. [Propose one](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/issues/new?template=mission.yml).

The story behind it: [Wi-Fi and its coprocessor](journey/f-wifi.md)

Campaign: [Campaign: The Whisperer](campaigns/wifi.md)

Its place in the hardware map: [Wi-Fi and its coprocessor](03-hardware-map.md#wi-fi-and-sdio)

## The Shy One

*Touch controller* · **Wounded**

**Goal** (bounded: reaching it does not mean the block is understood): Get an identified answer from the touch controller.

- **Down: seen on the phone.** The levels of its reset and chip-select lines, and the power registers that look like its supply and clock enables. - **Open.** Where its firmware comes from.
    - Attack it: [Where does the touch controller's firmware come from?](missions.md#mission-mt-boot-q1) (no phone) · [Does the touch driver class used by this model send the CHECK packet?](missions.md#mission-mt-check-q1) (no phone)
- **Open.** The polarity of its lines, and powering it.
    - No mission yet for this front. [Propose one](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/issues/new?template=mission.yml).
- **Open.** Any transaction on its bus, and any answer from it.
    - No mission yet for this front. [Propose one](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/issues/new?template=mission.yml).

## Take one on

Pick a front, then take its mission on the [Missions page](missions.md), or propose a mission for a front that has none. A front goes down when a pull request brings the proof, and the page is rebuilt from the data.
